subject.title: fix: setup fails closed for invalid configuration arguments

question: Should SetupEngine reject duplicates and flag-shaped values for all nine value-taking options, or should this PR narrowly fail closed only for explicit configuration inputs?
rationale: The explicit-config fallback is a clear bug, but universal strict parsing changes previously accepted automation behavior and no documented duplicate-option contract resolves that compatibility choice.

options.title: Narrow strictness to config
options.body: Reject invalid explicit `--config` inputs before setup while preserving existing behavior for unrelated repeated value options.

options.title: Approve strict parser
options.body: Accept strict validation across all nine options, then document the compatibility change and prove representative upgrade behavior.

options.title: Split parser follow-up
options.body: Land the explicit-config safety fix and review universal option strictness as a separate CLI-contract change.

recommendation.title: Narrow strictness to config
recommendation.body: Reject invalid explicit `--config` inputs before setup while preserving existing behavior for unrelated repeated value options.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history most strongly connects this person to setup safety, Windows onboarding, and adjacent argument parsing.
